{{Top|leg}}
The '''Likash''' (adj. Likashan) were members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] from the [[Likasha system/Legends|Likasha system]].<ref>{{Planetnamia|other=the Likash|system=[[Likasha system/Legends|Likasha system]]|legends=1}}</ref> During the last stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], their [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] took an aggressive stance, arguing that the New Republic military was powerful enough to utterly crush the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], despite the apparent return of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. The Likash had formerly been subjects of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].

Likashans had high-pitched voices.
